digest.component_or_area: transition request value object and close-reason/force plumbing
propositions: Close-reason and force plumbing logic is duplicated across three surfaces (CLI, library, MCP), each computing the same rule independently with inconsistent implementations.
CLI refuses an inadmissible close reason (exit 1) while the library silently discards it (returns 0), creating asymmetric behavior pinned by separate test suites.
MCP transition_ticket does not expose reason parameter, and the placeholder '(no reason given)' is produced in five code locations across multiple files without central definition.

An empty force_reason is falsy at txn.py:232 and depends on placeholder normalization occurring before the refusal check; moving that normalization would flip bare-force closes from accepted to refused.
The placeholder string literal must never flow into close_disposition.verdict, which fails closed on empty reasons and would incorrectly mark UNJUSTIFIED dispositions as SIGNED.

Convergence decision requires a behavior change: library must refuse inadmissible reasons identically to CLI, and MCP must gain reason parameter support, both flipping existing pinned test assertions.
